Statement: Enable accountable, traceable order and payment status from intake through allocation and reporting.
Rationale: Reduce uncertainty and prevent lost exceptions.
Acceptance: Representative normal, blocked, cancelled and partially paid cases expose current stage, owner, remaining quantity/balance and evidence gaps.
Dependencies: Master data; linked documents; agreed role access
Validation: Trace review and planned UAT TC-001;TC-014;TC-017

Statement: Base fulfilment commitments and release on feasible supply, customer agreement and financial controls.
Rationale: Avoid unsupported promises and unauthorized shipments.
Acceptance: Stock shortage, partial permission and block cases follow rules; measures KPI-001/002/003 use the agreed definitions; no achieved improvement claimed.
Dependencies: Stock accuracy; credit policy; transit assumptions
Validation: Planned UAT TC-004 through TC-008; synthetic KPI checks

Statement: Make eligible fulfilled deliveries visible to Finance for timely, accurate and traceable billing.
Rationale: Remove avoidable handoff waiting without billing incorrectly.
Acceptance: Eligible delivery appears in review population without an email; correction/duplicate/error paths retain links and owner; KPI-004 includes unbilled context.
Dependencies: Posting accuracy; billing relevance; Finance ownership
Validation: Planned UAT TC-012;TC-013;TC-022

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall prevent order confirmation until required customer and order fields are valid.
Rationale: Customer data validation addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
Acceptance: Missing ship-to address or inactive customer prevents confirmation, identifies the field and preserves the draft; corrected data can be rechecked
Dependencies: Customer owner; approved field list; RULE-001
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-002;TC-003

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall see quantities, dates, blocks, related documents and accountable owner in one order view.
Rationale: Order status visibility addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
Acceptance: NS-ORD-1001 shows 100 ordered, availability unresolved, requested receipt 9 October and no invented confirmation; unknown facts are labelled
Dependencies: Document relationships; FR-003; NFR-003; RULE-002
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-017;TC-021

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall check usable supply and commitments before promising quantity and date.
Rationale: Availability-based promises addresses PROB-002 and supports BR-002.
Acceptance: 100 ordered with only 60 confirmed available cannot be promised as 100 on the requested date; confirmed quantity/date and check time are retained
Dependencies: Stock accuracy; scheduling lead times; RULE-003
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-004

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall record customer agreement before splitting fulfilment.
Rationale: Partial delivery agreement addresses PROB-002 and supports BR-002.
Acceptance: With no partial-delivery permission, a 60/100 shipment is stopped for review; with recorded agreement, 60 can proceed and 40 remains open
Dependencies: FR-003; customer delivery policy; RULE-004
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-005;TC-006

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall hold blocked orders until the appropriate authorized review.
Rationale: Credit and order blocks addresses PROB-002 and supports BR-002.
Acceptance: An unresolved credit or manual order block prevents dispatch release; Sales cannot release a credit block; Finance review records decision, reason and actor
Dependencies: Credit limits; NFR-001; precise block configuration; RULE-005
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-007;TC-008

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall record actual pick, dispatch, goods-issue posting and customer receipt separately.
Rationale: Fulfilment and posting evidence addresses PROB-002 and supports BR-002.
Acceptance: Picked/shipped quantities do not exceed authorized remaining quantity; dispatch and posting dates remain distinct; receipt is never inferred from posting
Dependencies: FR-004; delivery documents; receipt evidence; RULE-006
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-005;TC-011

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall cancel unshipped demand without erasing transaction history.
Rationale: Controlled cancellation addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
Acceptance: Pre-dispatch cancellation records reason and removes demand from release queue; post-dispatch request routes to Finance/Warehouse review without deleting posted records
Dependencies: Document status checks; returns/reversal dependency; RULE-007
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-009;TC-010

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall review eligible dispatched deliveries without waiting for emailed paperwork.
Rationale: Billing readiness queue addresses PROB-003 and supports BR-003.
Acceptance: A goods-issued delivery enters the billing review population; blocked/incomplete entries show reason and owner; unbilled age remains visible
Dependencies: FR-006; billing relevance; daily review calendar; RULE-008
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-012;TC-022

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall bill eligible delivered quantities once and track posting/output status.
Rationale: Invoice creation and duplicate control addresses PROB-003 and supports BR-003.
Acceptance: For 60 brackets at £25, net billing is £1,500; retry must not create a second active charge for the same quantity; posting/output failures remain visible
Dependencies: FR-008; pricing/tax master data; document linkage; RULE-009
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-012;TC-013;TC-022

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall correct invoice errors through linked reviewed adjustments.
Rationale: Invoice correction addresses PROB-003 and supports BR-003.
Acceptance: A wrong-price invoice is marked disputed and routed for review; correction preserves original reference and reason; no silent overwrite of a posted invoice
Dependencies: Correction method and tax treatment unresolved; RULE-009
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-013

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall match full and partial receipts while exposing unallocated balances.
Rationale: Payment allocation addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
Acceptance: Against £1,500 net-only illustrative invoice, £900 allocation leaves £600 analytical balance; unmatched £200 stays unallocated; allocation cannot exceed receipt or invoice balance
Dependencies: Customer reference; chosen partial vs residual policy; RULE-010
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-014;TC-015;TC-016

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall assign each open exception to an owner and next action.
Rationale: Exception ownership addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
Priority_reason: Supports operation; interim documented control possible
Acceptance: Each open exception has order reference, category, accountable role and review date; overdue reviews appear in queue without exposing unauthorized finance detail
Dependencies: Role matrix; escalation policy; RULE-002
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-017

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall calculate consistent measures without multiplying order values.
Rationale: KPI definitions and reconciliation addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
Acceptance: Known fixture with two deliveries and two allocations retains one order value; cancelled/open/partial cases follow KPI contract; totals reconcile to source grains
Dependencies: Approved definitions; receipt capture; FR-006; FR-011; RULE-011
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-018

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall restrict sensitive actions to accountable roles.
Rationale: Role-based access addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
Acceptance: Warehouse cannot change credit limits; Sales cannot approve credit release; Finance can perform authorized review; both allowed and denied actions tested
Dependencies: NFR-001; named users; role design; RULE-005
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-007;TC-008;TC-019

Statement: The proposed process/solution shall trace critical changes and understand report freshness and errors.
Rationale: Audit and usable reporting addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
Priority_reason: Supports operation; interim documented control possible
Acceptance: For promise/block/billing changes capture actor, time, before/after and reason; reports show as-of time; a user can locate order owner without a workaround
Dependencies: NFR-002;NFR-003;NFR-004;NFR-005; logging scope; RULE-012
Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-020;TC-021

Statement: Access permissions shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
Rationale: Unauthorized financial actions are unacceptable, so tolerance is zero.
Priority_reason: Unauthorized financial actions are unacceptable, so tolerance is zero.
Acceptance: Every allow/deny action in the role matrix must match the proposed role restriction; zero unauthorized credit releases in the defined test set.
Dependencies: FR-014; RULE-005
Validation: Role matrix review and positive/negative system tests

Statement: Auditability shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
Rationale: All sampled critical events must be explainable; this is coverage, not a retention-law claim.
Priority_reason: All sampled critical events must be explainable; this is coverage, not a retention-law claim.
Acceptance: For every sampled promise, block release and invoice correction, retain actor, timestamp, before/after and reason; retention duration requires policy decision.
Dependencies: FR-015; record retention decision
Validation: Inspect audit records and compare controlled changes

Statement: Reporting timeliness shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
Rationale: A daily meeting is the business use case; real-time integration is not justified yet.
Priority_reason: A daily meeting is the business use case; real-time integration is not justified yet.
Acceptance: Daily management snapshot available before the proposed 09:00 Europe/London operations review with as-of timestamp; stale snapshot displays a warning.
Dependencies: FR-013; schedule; timezone conversion
Validation: Delay refresh deliberately and inspect timestamp/warning

Statement: Usability shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
Rationale: One person per role is formative coverage, not a statistically representative usability study.
Priority_reason: One person per role is formative coverage, not a statistically representative usability study.
Acceptance: Each of five proposed role representatives can locate an order, its owner and next action using the guide; record completion, errors and time before agreeing a timing target.
Dependencies: FR-002; FR-015; participants unavailable
Validation: Moderated tasks; no participants tested in this portfolio

Statement: Data quality and reconciliation shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
Rationale: Exact arithmetic is appropriate for keys and ledger-like reconciliation; incomplete business data is separately flagged.
Priority_reason: Exact arithmetic is appropriate for keys and ledger-like reconciliation; incomplete business data is separately flagged.
Acceptance: Required keys are unique/non-null, child references valid, quantities and allocations within parent bounds, and integer-pence balances reconcile exactly.
Dependencies: FR-013; data dictionary
Validation: Executed Python/SQLite checks; SAP extraction validation still required
